Class Stats

java.lang.Object
models.bugemon.Stats
public class Stats extends Object
Represents the statistics of a Bugémon. Stores its maximum health points, current health points, attack, defense and initiative. Provides methods to modify or reduce health during battles.

    • getXpThreshold

      public int getXpThreshold()
      Computes the XP threshold required to reach the next level. Formula from the specification (Section 3.2.4.1): Level n -> (n+1) : 50 + 100 * (n - 1) XP Examples: level 1->2 = 50, level 2->3 = 150, level 3->4 = 250
      Returns:
      the amount of XP needed to level up

      public void levelUp()
